title: Practice: the Clockwork
summary: A small game against an Easy computer playing the Brood, with hints along the way. Kill the Brood Mother to win.

say: A real game now, against an easy computer playing the Brood. I will give you hints.
The Brood has no buildings: kill its Brood Mother to win. First, more Winders.
Good. A second Cog Press, a Mainspring with Winders on it, and a Light Works. Mind the rings mesh.
Keep the Light Works busy: Clock Soldiers, one after another.

say.pc: The Brood nests in the far corner. Gather your army, press A and click there. Strike the Mother.
say.phone: The Brood nests in the far corner. Gather your army, tap ATTACK and tap there. Strike the Mother.

say: Winders go with the army to repair it.

late1.text: Your brass runs out in time. Build a second Clocktower at the foot of your ramp: fresh ground.

lost: The computer won this time. Build up, defend your ramp, and try again.

you.text: You won a whole game. You are ready for a skirmish, or the campaign.
